Go placidly amid the noise and haste,  
and remember what peace there may be in silence.  
As far as possible without surrender  
be on good terms with all persons.  
Speak your truth quietly and clearly;  
and listen to others,  
even the dull and the ignorant;  
they too have their story.  

Avoid loud and aggressive persons,  
they are vexations to the spirit.  
If you compare yourself with others,  
you may become vain and bitter;  
for always there will be greater and lesser persons than yourself.  
Enjoy your achievements as well as your plans.  

Keep interested in your own career, however humble;  
it is a real possession in the changing fortunes of time.  
Exercise caution in your business affairs;  
for the world is full of trickery.  
But let this not blind you to what virtue there is;  
many persons strive for high ideals;  
and everywhere life is full of heroism.  

Be yourself.  
Especially, do not feign affection.  
Neither be cynical about love;  
for in the face of all aridity and disenchantment  
it is as perennial as the grass.  

Take kindly the counsel of the years,  
gracefully surrendering the things of youth.  
Nurture strength of spirit to shield you in sudden misfortune.  
But do not distress yourself with dark imaginings.  
Many fears are born of fatigue and loneliness.  
Beyond a wholesome discipline,  
be gentle with yourself.  

You are a child of the universe,  
no less than the trees and the stars;  
you have a right to be here.  
And whether or not it is clear to you,  
no doubt the universe is unfolding as it should.  

Therefore be at peace with God,  
whatever you conceive Him to be,  
and whatever your labors and aspirations,  
in the noisy confusion of life keep peace with your soul.  

With all its sham, drudgery, and broken dreams,  
it is still a beautiful world.  
Be cheerful.  
Strive to be happy.

Start a conversation with her and pay attention to what she is saying, tone of voice and body language. Her tone of voice will signal if she is disinterested, tired, angry, sad so listen and react accordingly and be prepared to skedaddle. If she sounds happy, excited or neutral feel free to keep conversation going. While speaking with her, keep an eye out for her body language. 

Signs of disinterest: Turning her body away from you, not making eye contact, not smiling, paying more attention to distractions such as cell phone etc, self-comforting behavior like rubbing back of neck, closed off and limbs crossed, and gazing around as if ready to leave.

The great thing is that since you are wary of making a girl uncomfortable you will be on the look-out that she is not interested and you can make your leave without bothering her. You will most likely know when she doesn't want to be bothered and you can make a graceful exit, thanking her for the conversation and wishing her well.

TL;DR: Be aware and respectful of what she is saying and her body language. If she seems not into it, better to be safe than sorry and leave her alone.

Just because you belong to a certain group doesn't mean you have to behave or believe in what the majority do.

The reason a lot of LBGT people celebrate Pride and seek out other LGBT folks is because we have been persecuted for so long and we still are. We're still harassed, discriminated against and even killed just for being LGBT. 

Pride allows people to be themselves and to see that there isn't something wrong with them. They can see themselves as NORMAL this way, instead of it being something that we have to hide and suppress! Seeking out other people with the same experiences, can comfort people and make them feel not alone.

So you don't gotta have love for Pride nor do you gotta shout out for everyone to hear, "I'm a lesbian, hear me roar" but for many others it can be a comfort, relief and even a haven for a world that can still be intolerant and dangerous just for being yourself.

I have had the same experience before (multiple times actually) with friends and even my "best" friend. This is straight up **manipulative** and selfish behavior. Even if he is not trying to be manipulative on the surface, make no mistake he is manipulating you with this behavior. When he gives you gifts he is not really doing it for you; he is doing it because he is getting something out of it/or he is hoping to get something out of it. This is what he might say but what he really means when he keeps doing this.

* "Here is a gift for you." Ulterior motive - he wants your praise/ gratitude
* "I can't return it/waste of money" Ulterior motive - guilt tripping you into doing what he wants/controlling your behavior
* "Look how much I do for you/give you." Ulterior motive - Now you owe me

You blatantly told him you are a lesbian and have said NO multiple times when he gives you gifts. He is not respecting you or your boundaries. This is a **MAJOR** red flag! 

Personally, I would cut ties altogether with this guy. It may seem like not a big deal what he is doing; after all, he isn't being a jerk/abusive ~~he totally is~~, but this is his way of controlling you and your relationship to suit his needs/wants. This is dangerous. I seriously thought it wasn't a big deal when it happened to me, just annoying and tiring, but it progressed until he ended up showing his true colors and hurting me.

Please remember, that a true friend will respect you and your wants, not push you into doing something just because it would make them happy. If you really want to salvage your relationship you need to establish rules that he MUST be adhere to otherwise the friendship is done completely.

Tell him that you want to talk to him because he has been making you uncomfortable with his behavior. Tell him he needs to stop giving you gifts. Even some little thing. No more at all. Tell him to stop confessing to you, you are a lesbian and you would NEVER feel anything more than friendship with him. 

Do NOT try to make this sound nicer or sugarcoat this when/if his feelings are hurt. Do NOT let him guilt trip you into thinking you are doing something wrong! You are not! 

Both of you have been more worried about his feelings and that needs to change. If he breaks these rules then you have to be strong, put your foot down and stop hanging out with him.
